summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **What I did first:** had a sub-agent trace the full chain (schema → handlers → auth middleware → client → live DB) before proposing any plan, since this touches auth. Summary of what it found:  - `watchlists.user_id` is NOT NULL, indexed, same shape as `portfolios` — no guest/default watchlist concept, no schema gap. - Every handler resolves the watchlist via `getUserId(c)` (from `X-User-Id`, injected only after a valid session lookup) and filters by `(id, user_id)` — no anonymous fallback, no body-supplied id. - The watchli
